name: com.kajitaharuka.unity-editor-localization
description:
Lightweight localization foundation for Unity Editor extensions. Editor-only with no runtime or Unity Localization dependency: per-scope JSON translation catalogs, manifest-driven locale tags (add a locale by adding a translation JSON and registering it in the manifest), per-user language selection saved to EditorPrefs with OS-language auto-follow, UI Toolkit binding helpers (labels, buttons, PropertyFields, language menus), catalog hot-reload, and validation for missing keys and placeholder mismatches.
Unity Editor拡張向けの軽量な多言語化基盤。Editor専用でランタイムやUnity Localizationに依存せず、scope単位のJSON翻訳カタログ、manifestの文字列タグによるロケール管理（翻訳JSONの追加とmanifestへの登録でロケールを増設。C#の変更は不要）、EditorPrefs保存のユーザー別言語設定とOS言語への自動追従、UI Toolkit向けバインド補助（ラベル・ボタン・PropertyField・言語メニュー）、カタログの自動リロード、欠落キー・placeholder不一致の検証を提供。

samples.description: Interactive UI Toolkit editor window demonstrating labels, buttons, tooltips, locale switching, validation, and translation workflow guidance.
